audit_phase: Phase 3.5 — Final Independent Research Validation and Publication Readiness Audit
project: An AI-Driven DL–ML Integrated Framework for Crop Yield Prediction Using Environmental Factors

dataset.target: hg/ha_yield (converted to tonnes/ha by dividing by 10,000.0)

stacking_09822_vs_09815_resolution.finding: Both metrics represent the DL–ML Stacking Meta-Ensemble evaluated on the exact same 80/20 naive random split (5,187 test rows).

score_09815.variation_explanation: Delta of 0.0007 R2 is due to PyTorch Tabular Neural Network stochastic backpropagation across separate training runs.

stacking_09822_vs_09815_resolution.critical_caveat: The 0.9822 / 0.9815 performance is inflated by 58.67% test row repeated-tuple leakage across the train/test boundary and does NOT represent performance on unobserved environmental conditions.

evaluation_regimes.scientific_interpretation: Interpolation accuracy under observation pseudo-replication. Highly accurate for interpolating weather-station variations for known country-crop-years.
True generalization accuracy to unseen (Area, Item, Year) environmental combinations. Random Forest marginally outperforms complex stacking due to tree robustness.
Evaluates forward temporal transferability. Substantial degradation (~0.06 R2 loss, ~0.40 t/ha RMSE increase) occurs due to evolving agrarian technology and climate shifts.

evaluation_regimes.regime: 4. Geographic Block Split (Held-Out Countries / Zero-Shot Spatial)
evaluation_regimes.scientific_interpretation: Evaluates spatial zero-shot transferability. Severe failure (R2 drops below 0.50, RMSE triples to ~4.0 t/ha). Proves models rely heavily on country identity as a proxy for unobserved soil, governance, and infrastructure.
Deployed for sub-5ms low latency, determinism, and exact TreeSHAP compatibility. Serves as production engine while stacking is maintained as offline research benchmark.

plantains_discrepancy_resolution.reported_in_phase3_3: Plantains test row coverage = 86.41%, mean width = 7.461 t/ha, Q = 3.7333 t/ha
plantains_discrepancy_resolution.root_cause_identified: Phase 3.4 JSON mistakenly transposed the calibration row count of Yams (92) onto Plantains (whose actual calibration row count was 79). 84/92 was 91.30%.

task3_group_aware_conformal_verification.method: Group Maximum Nonconformity Score R_g = max_{i in g} |y_{g,i} - y_hat_{g,i}|
task3_group_aware_conformal_verification.exchangeability_assumptions: Group-level marginal validity requires that calibration and test groups are exchangeable i.i.d. draws from the agricultural system. Valid under randomized GroupShuffleSplit. Invalid under temporal shifts (>2013) or geographic zero-shot shifts.

treeshap_validation.feature_alignment: 113 transformed sparse columns exactly matched to estimator trees

fallback_and_clipping.unknown_crop_fallback: VERIFIED (dragonfruit falls back to global group-max 2.573 t/ha)

publication_claim_matrix.claim: The DL-ML Stacking Ensemble achieves R2 = 0.9822 under naive random splitting.
publication_claim_matrix.caveat: High score is heavily driven by repeated (Area, Item, Year) observations across train/test splits. True grouped generalization is R2 = 0.9671.

publication_claim_matrix.claim: Group-max conformal calibration guarantees marginal coverage (>=90%) across exchangeable groups.
publication_claim_matrix.caveat: Applies marginally across exchangeable groups; does not guarantee 90% for every individual crop or temporal shift.

publication_claim_matrix.claim: Crop-conditional calibration guarantees 90% coverage for every crop family.
publication_claim_matrix.caveat: Soybeans (86.83%), Sweet potatoes (86.18%), and Plantains (86.41%) fall below nominal 90% coverage due to heteroskedastic residual tails and small sample sizes.

publication_claim_matrix.claim: The model provides zero-shot geographic transfer to unobserved countries.
publication_claim_matrix.caveat: R2 collapses to 0.4481 under spatial block splitting. Unobserved country predictions require local retraining or recalibration.

publication_claim_matrix.claim: Live production inference serves standalone XGBoost with exact TreeSHAP attributions in <10ms.
publication_claim_matrix.caveat: Live API does not serve the 4-model stacking ensemble; TreeSHAP efficiency error is < 1e-6 t/ha.
